text: Kefalotyri is a cooked hard cheese of sheep's or goat's milk. It has no protected name or single legal recipe; the cultures listed are those of a 2025 semi-industrial Epirus study of a Kefalotyri-type cheese, not a rule for every maker.

processing.text: Cultures are those of a 2025 Epirus study cheese ripened 90 d; the L. plantarum and Leuconostoc strains are adjuncts of the study, and one L. lactis strain makes nisin A. Native S. thermophilus and L. lactis grow best in the first 24 h; later mesophilic lactic bacteria and the L. plantarum adjunct dominate.
